goal: In bokkio-interactions-fixture set Search to "P5 cross app one" and click Submit so its status is "Submitted: P5 cross app one". Then in Bokkio Jev hard click Action in Right pane so its status is "Clicked Right pane".

steps.goal: In the Bokkio interactions window of bokkio-interactions-fixture, set the Search text field to P5 cross app one.
In the Bokkio interactions window of bokkio-interactions-fixture, click the Submit button so the status label reads Submitted: P5 cross app one.
In the Bokkio Jev hard window, hard click the Action button inside the Right pane group (not the one in Left pane) so the status label reads Clicked Right pane.
